question: How is the constant washing of the mouth symbolically identified in this teaching?
premises: Washing of the mouth is to be done always.
It is described as having gone upward.
inference: The constant washing of the mouth is identified as that which has gone upward to Brahman.
uncertainties: The symbolic or ritual meaning of ūrddha-gatam in relation to Brahman is open to interpretation.
plain_english: O beloved, the constant washing of the mouth is that which has gone upward to Brahman.
